title: Gated effects execute under a durable approval
description: `commit` and `finalize` have never executed: noop grants nothing and nothing in this repo ever runs them under another mechanism, so commit's span is always interrupted/FailClosed. Give them a durable approval path so their bodies actually run.

successCriteria.description: A run supplied with a durable approval record executes the commit node's body: its span status is 'ok', not 'interrupted' with errorClass FailClosed.
Fail-closed is NOT weakened: with no approval record present, the effect is still refused. Pinned by a test that fails if the guard is removed.
commit and finalize are removed from NEVER_EXECUTED (src/pge/golden/coverage.test.ts:139-146) and the list's two-directional guard still fails if a node silently re-enters it.
The approval record is durable in the sense interrupt.ts:38-46 means — it survives process exit and is not synthesised by the harness at run time.
Every golden case whose recorded artifacts move is re-captured in THIS sprint, with each diff hunk read and confined to the newly-executing nodes and their direct consequences.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, and the golden gate passing at or above its replay floor.

nonGoals: Changing deriveRunSuccess or the completion marker — Option A stays frozen.
stopConditions: Making commit execute requires the golden executor to stop pinning one config, which would make cases irreproducible — stop and report rather than trading reproducibility for coverage.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: Four mechanisms are registered at src/pge/runtime/interrupt.ts:318 (cli, disk, pr, noop); `disk` is the obvious durable one. The grant rule is :523 `if (mechanismName !== "noop") granted.set(key, outcome)`. The shipped conformanceConfig() is autopilot by construction and the golden executor pins it deliberately so cases reproduce — do NOT unpin that. The likely shape is a second, explicitly-approved config used by new cases, leaving the autopilot path exactly as it is. commit is a git-effect node: make sure executing it in a test cannot touch the real repo. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
evaluatorNotes: Two things to hammer. First, that fail-closed still holds: delete the approval record and confirm the effect is refused again. Second, that commit's body running in a test cannot mutate the real repository — check where its git effect points. Then verify the coverage list actually shrank rather than the guard being relaxed. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
